title: Unpivot Quarterly Onboarding Completion Rates
prompt: You are analyzing onboarding completion rates for new hires across departments. The `dept_onboarding_quarterly` table stores completion percentages for each fiscal quarter in wide format, with each quarter as a separate column. The `dept_code` column uses standard NAICS-inspired department abbreviations stored as text (may have leading/trailing spaces). The `fiscal_year` is stored as TEXT and must be cast to INTEGER for filtering. The `region_tags` column is an ARRAY of US state abbreviations where the department operates. The `last_updated` column is a TIMESTAMP. You need to reshape this data into long format with one row per department-quarter combination. Output columns must be: `dept_code` (trimmed and uppercased), `fiscal_year` (as INTEGER), `primary_region` (the first element from region_tags array), `quarter_label`, `completion_pct` (rounded to 1 decimal place), and `update_month` (extracted as the month number from last_updated). For the quarter labels, use: 'Q1' for q1_completion_pct, 'Q2' for q2_completion_pct, 'Q3' for q3_completion_pct, and 'Q4' for q4_completion_pct. Exclude any rows where the completion percentage is NULL. Order the final result by dept_code ASC, then fiscal_year ASC, then quarter_label ASC. This table structure is modeled on public sector workforce analytics datasets.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE dept_onboarding_quarterly (dept_code TEXT, fiscal_year TEXT, q1_completion_pct NUMERIC(5,2), q2_completion_pct NUMERIC(5,2), q3_completion_pct NUMERIC(5,2), q4_completion_pct NUMERIC(5,2), region_tags TEXT[], last_updated TIMESTAMP);
example_input_data: INSERT INTO dept_onboarding_quarterly (dept_code, fiscal_year, q1_completion_pct, q2_completion_pct, q3_completion_pct, q4_completion_pct, region_tags, last_updated) VALUES ('  hr  ', '2023', 87.50, 92.30, NULL, 88.75, ARRAY['CA', 'NY', 'TX'], '2023-05-15 10:30:00'), ('IT', '2023', 78.00, 81.50, 85.20, 90.10, ARRAY['WA', 'OR'], '2023-06-20 14:15:00'), (' finance ', '2024', 95.25, 97.80, 96.50, 98.00, ARRAY['IL', 'NJ'], '2024-03-10 09:00:00');

composite_moves: reshape: unpivot 4 wide columns (q1_completion_pct, q2_completion_pct, q3_completion_pct, q4_completion_pct) into long format using UNION ALL with literal quarter labels
prep: STRING cleaning — TRIM and UPPER the dept_code
prep: TYPE CAST — cast fiscal_year from TEXT to INTEGER
prep: ARRAY — extract region_tags[1] as primary_region
prep: NUMERIC — ROUND completion_pct to 1 decimal place
prep: DATE — EXTRACT month from last_updated timestamp
prep: NULL handling — exclude rows WHERE source column IS NULL (each UNION branch filters its own column)
finalize: ORDER BY dept_code ASC, fiscal_year ASC, quarter_label ASC

hints: You need to transform columns into rows; think about how to create a new row for each quarter column.
Use UNION ALL to stack multiple SELECT statements, one per quarter column, each with a literal label like 'Q1', 'Q2', etc. Don't forget to filter out NULL values in each branch.

Each SELECT in the UNION ALL should extract: UPPER(TRIM(dept_code)), fiscal_year::INTEGER, region_tags[1], the quarter label as a literal string, ROUND(the quarter column, 1), and EXTRACT(MONTH FROM last_updated). Add WHERE <quarter_column> IS NOT NULL to each branch, then order the final result by dept_code, fiscal_year, quarter_label.
answer_key: SELECT UPPER(TRIM(dept_code)) AS dept_code, fiscal_year::INTEGER AS fiscal_year, region_tags[1] AS primary_region, 'Q1' AS quarter_label, ROUND(q1_completion_pct, 1) AS completion_pct, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM last_updated)::INTEGER AS update_month FROM dept_onboarding_quarterly WHERE q1_completion_pct IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT UPPER(TRIM(dept_code)), fiscal_year::INTEGER, region_tags[1], 'Q2', ROUND(q2_completion_pct, 1), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM last_updated)::INTEGER FROM dept_onboarding_quarterly WHERE q2_completion_pct IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT UPPER(TRIM(dept_code)), fiscal_year::INTEGER, region_tags[1], 'Q3', ROUND(q3_completion_pct, 1), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM last_updated)::INTEGER FROM dept_onboarding_quarterly WHERE q3_completion_pct IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT UPPER(TRIM(dept_code)), fiscal_year::INTEGER, region_tags[1], 'Q4', ROUND(q4_completion_pct, 1), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM last_updated)::INTEGER FROM dept_onboarding_quarterly WHERE q4_completion_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dept_code ASC, fiscal_year ASC, quarter_label ASC;

_meta.scenario: an HR platform tracking onboarding completion and benefits enrollment
